boundary_assessment.historical_validation_boundary: Validate the frozen C4 base against the exact 86-row ledger state that existed immediately before Joern03. The 87th row is continuation-04 history and must be validated by continuation-02 through OLD_CONTRACT_SHA/source/plan identity, not silently passed through the C4 validator.
boundary_assessment.why_previous_continuation_passed: continuation-01 ran while the live ledger ended at its own sealed predecessor boundary; continuation-02 now runs after one additional append, so the frozen C4 packet sees a new contract tail row.

observed_failure.cause: The frozen C4 validator is correctly strict for its own resource-recovery packet. That packet seals the 57-row C1/C2/C3 prefix and treats rows after it as C4 rows. With the current ledger, its packet tail contains the 86 historical C4 rows plus the newly appended Joern03 row. _validate_scoped_tail checks every packet tail row against the C4 contract bytes, so the C5/continuation-04 Joern03 row is rejected before continuation-02 can recover its exact older context.
observed_failure.reported_error: post-prefix ledger row is not registered to the exact C3 contract

activation_guard: Only around the single base executor.validate_plan call.
Require validated target is BASE_SHA exactly.
Require the actual live ledger has exactly 87 rows.
Require row[86] equals the exact Joern03 attempt/group/status/OLD_CONTRACT_SHA/source/plan identity above.
proposed_narrow_runtime_correction.explicit_non_solution: Do not truncate or rewrite ledger-v1.jsonl, patch the frozen executor, blanket-catch the C4 error, or filter arbitrary rows by contract SHA.
proposed_narrow_runtime_correction.kind: scoped in-memory adapter; no source or ledger mutation
packet_integrity_precondition: Require the frozen resource-recovery packet prefix_rows plus tail_rows, including line hashes, exactly equals the current 87-row ledger snapshot.
Require packet tail[-1] is exactly row[86]; reject any other suffix or missing boundary row.
Make a shallow packet copy and pass only tail_rows[:-1] to the original frozen _validate_scoped_tail.
Restore the original frozen function in a finally block; do not catch or downgrade any ReleaseError.
proposed_narrow_runtime_correction.preserved_checks: The original frozen _validate_scoped_tail remains unchanged for all C4 rows. continuation-02 _check_prefix validates all 87 sealed rows, _historical_contexts validates Joern03 against OLD_CONTRACT_SHA and its exact source/plan, _tail rejects more than Joern04/CodeQL01, and _validate_tail_identity validates all future continuation rows. Unknown contracts, corrupted row 86, altered line hashes, or extra tail rows fail closed before the adapter can remove a row.
